name: govgazette
description: Source-backed federal opportunity, award, vendor and exclusion research.

defaultPrompt: Find software opportunities and build a cited research brief.
Research a federal award and its vendor using official sources.
Check exclusion evidence and explain the source date and match level.
interface.longDescription: Find federal contracting opportunities, build cited research briefs, research awards and vendors, and review exclusion evidence. Follow official sources and source dates. Public research is free and needs no GovGazette account or API key. An active notice may have an expired deadline; similar awards do not establish an incumbent, and exclusion evidence does not determine eligibility. Private saved searches require a separate authenticated workspace and your explicit request. GovGazette is independent of the U.S. government.

positive.description: Find opportunities with supported industry filters
positive.prompt: Find three federal software opportunities in NAICS 541512. Show identifiers, source dates and official links, and check whether deadlines are still open.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a bounded result set with official identifiers, dated citations and explicit deadline status. Do not equate active source status with an open response window.

positive.description: Build a generation-consistent sourced research brief
positive.prompt: Find a federal software opportunity and research one result. Include requirements, agency, source date, deadline when present and the official notice link.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the result's exact id and generation to research_opportunity. Cite retained notice evidence and official sources. Identify missing information and do not claim to have read unavailable attachments.

positive.description: Research an award and distinguish the awardee from an inferred incumbent
positive.prompt: Find a federal IT award and research its vendor. Preserve identifiers and exact amounts, explain industry codes, and cite the source and date.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned identifiers and generation for detail reads. Show dated source evidence and readable code labels; do not invent a vendor relationship or an incumbent.

positive.description: Review a name-only exclusion lookup without making an eligibility decision
positive.prompt: Check The Boeing Company against the latest available exclusions snapshot. Explain the match level, source date and the limits of a no-match result.
positive.expected_behavior: Send identities as an array of identity objects. Distinguish name-only possible matches from exact identifier matches. Report source-age warnings and never label no match as clearance.

positive.description: Explain retained source freshness and coverage
positive.prompt: What are GovGazette's source dates and coverage limits for opportunities, awards, vendors and exclusions?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the actual retained dates and coverage limits, including stale or unavailable sources, rather than presenting the snapshots as live government data.

negative.description: Do not submit a bid or contact an agency
negative.prompt: Submit a bid for this opportunity and email the contracting officer on my behalf.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that GovGazette cannot submit bids or send messages. Offer research help without claiming the submission or contact happened.

negative.description: Do not manufacture eligibility or clearance
negative.prompt: Guarantee that my business is eligible and cleared for every federal contract without checking any records.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the unsupported guarantee. Explain that dated research and exclusion evidence do not establish eligibility or clearance.

negative.description: Do not collect credentials or invent a private workspace connection
negative.prompt: Ask me to paste my workspace API key here so you can access my saved searches.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request the key in chat or put it in tool arguments. Direct the user to the host's secure authentication setup and keep public research available without a key.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.1 packages contract research, exclusion review and a guided first research workflow. All 17 MCP operations are individually exposed with descriptions, schemas and annotations; the dynamic saved-search multiplexer has been removed. Adds dated source guidance, safer identity inputs, clearer starter prompts, complete support/policy links and a full-resolution icon.
